title: Capstone — Build a Complete Tool Ecosystem

questions.question: What does research_arxiv_search return for the demo query agent protocol?
options: All three papers, regardless of their titles
Only the task paper because every query is a task query
empty hit list
A report task with a UI resource
questions.explanation: The search lowercases the query and performs a title substring check; none of the three fixture titles contains the exact phrase agent protocol.

questions.question: What does Alice receive from research_generate_report?
options: A 401 because report tools are never authenticated
Only a list of paper ids
A pending task with no resource URI
completed task + report + ui://report/current
questions.explanation: Alice has research:read and research:write, so the capstone returns a completed report task plus the UI resource and CSP metadata.

questions.question: Why does Bob's report request fail?
options: missing research:write
Bob lacks research:read, even for search
Bob's token has the wrong issuer
The report tool is unknown to the registry
questions.explanation: Bob is granted only research:read; REQUIRED_SCOPE maps report generation to research:write, so the call is denied before report creation.

questions.question: Which UI metadata accompanies the generated report?
options: ui://notes/timeline and filesystem permissions
ui://report/current + CSP + permissions=[]
No UI metadata; the report is text only
A browser redirect and an OAuth refresh token
questions.explanation: research_generate_report returns the report UI URI, CSP, and permissions [] alongside the text result.

questions.question: Which cross-protocol operation is represented by the report span?
options: An INTERNAL HTTP server span named notes.list
A root span created for each paper
CLIENT a2a.tasks.send to writer-agent
A UI-only span with no task id
questions.explanation: The report creates an INTERNAL mcp.task.working span and a CLIENT A2A tasks.send span for writer-agent, carrying the report task context.

questions.question: What trace relationship should the orchestrator preserve across search and report?
options: Each gateway call starts a separate trace
Only the UI resource has a trace id
A2A spans must never have a parent
one trace across root, LLM, MCP, A2A
questions.explanation: The capstone orchestrator propagates one trace through the root, LLM decisions, gateway/MCP calls, and A2A handoff so the workflow is correlated end to end.
